notes: GRAPHICS: UPSCALER (Settings > Video): OFF / QUALITY / BALANCED / PERFORMANCE - draws the world smaller and sharpens it back up for more FPS, the HUD stays sharp
GRAPHICS: BOUNCE LIGHT - light bounces off nearby walls and floors (on in ULTRA)
GRAPHICS: RAY-TRACED SHADOWS - real rays traced against the map for far shadows and sky occlusion (ULTRA+)
PHOTO MODE: RAY TRACE button - traces many rays a pixel for soft shadows and bounce light, then save the picture
